items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: They had a boy named Big Boy Goudie.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he was buying camels and living it up, he and his buddies. So Chitteson, we all got together and were going to get him. They had a boy named Big Boy Goudie. (inaudible), Big Boy would have trouble getting in that door. And Chitteson used to take his money away from him. He was bigger than Chitteson, but he was on his knees shooting crap and he just picked the money up and bass at him: "I don't give you nothing!" And Big Boy said, "But Chitteson, don't take my money away from me." Chitterson walked off.…
